# XJSON Tutor Brains — SCXQ2 Hex Dumps

> **GitHub binary policy note:** The `.bin` artifacts are binary. This repo stores hex in `.md` files. To create binaries, save the hex to `.hex` and run:
>
> ```bash
> xxd -r -p brain_intro.hex > brain_intro.scxq2.bin
> ```
>
> Repeat per brain. These binaries must be **manually created** from the hex blocks below.

## Common Header Template (all brains)

```
53 43 58 32        // SCX2
01 00              // version
01 00              // flags
<8 bytes>          // brain_id
<8 bytes>          // payload_hash
04 00 00 00        // lanes = 4
00 00 00 00
```

Lane order:
0 = concepts
1 = explanations
2 = edges
3 = proofs

## Brain Merge Tool (Reference)

Use the merge tool to build a federated tutor brain from the chapter binaries:

```bash
brain merge brain_intro.bin brain_grams.bin brain_graph.bin \
  brain_execution.bin brain_compression.bin brain_proofs.bin \
  brain_federation.bin brain_policy.bin brain_models.bin brain_build.bin \
  -o brain_tutor_federated.bin
```

### Deterministic Merge Algorithm (Pseudo-code)

```text
for each brain:
  parse lanes
  for concept in lane0:
    if string_hash exists → reuse ID
    else → assign new federated ID

for edges:
  if (src, dst) exists:
    weight = min((w1 + w2) * 0.85, MAX)
  else:
    insert edge

preserve:
  - all explanations
  - all proofs (union)
```
